subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve active connections across runtime reloads

question: Should WhatsApp intentionally retain the first injected channel runtime as the process-lifetime context owner across every supported plugin-registry reload mode until connection tasks dispose their leases?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes lifecycle ownership to preserve outbound controller discovery; source-level consistency is clear, but confirmation that this lifetime rule is the intended long-term channel contract requires owner judgment.

options.title: Confirm stable owner lifetime
options.body: Accept the first-injected channel runtime as the durable lease owner and merge after the normal exact-head checks finish.

options.title: Define a narrower reload boundary
options.body: Specify a reload event that must retire or migrate existing controller leases, then revise the patch and tests around that explicit boundary.

recommendation.title: Confirm stable owner lifetime
recommendation.body: Accept the first-injected channel runtime as the durable lease owner and merge after the normal exact-head checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available repository member most directly connected to both the proposed runtime invariant and its stacked WhatsApp QA validation.
